summary: When Goliath fell, the Philistines ran away, and Israel's army, who had been hiding in fear, finally found courage and chased them. Saul asked whose son this brave boy was.

story_reel.narration: When the Philistines saw that their mighty champion had fallen, they turned and ran! And something amazing happened to Israel's army. For forty days, they had been too afraid to move. But now, after seeing one young shepherd trust God, they found their courage. The soldiers of Israel and Judah jumped up, shouted a battle cry, and chased the Philistines all the way back to their own cities. One boy's brave faith gave a whole army courage! David didn't win that day because he was strong or because he had good weapons. He had a sling and a stone. He won because he trusted that the battle belonged to Yahweh. King Saul watched all this happen. He turned to Abner, the commander of his army, and asked, 'Whose son is this young man?' Abner said, 'I honestly don't know, my king.' So when David came back, Saul asked him himself, 'Whose son are you, young man?' David answered, 'I am the son of your servant Jesse of Bethlehem.' Courage is contagious. When you trust God and stand firm, other people around you can find courage too.

scenes.caption: The Philistines run!
scenes.art_direction: The Philistine army turning and fleeing across the valley; shown from a distance.

scenes.caption: Courage spreads
scenes.art_direction: One by one, Israelite soldiers standing up from hiding, their faces lighting up.

scenes.caption: A battle cry
scenes.art_direction: The whole army shouting and charging down the hill together; no fighting shown.

scenes.caption: A sling and a stone
scenes.art_direction: Close-up of David's simple sling, glowing softly.

scenes.caption: 'Whose son is this?'
scenes.art_direction: Saul pointing at David and asking Abner, who shrugs.

scenes.caption: 'The son of Jesse'
scenes.art_direction: David standing before Saul, humble and smiling.

memory_verse.text: greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

identity_focus.core_truth: When I trust Yahweh and stand firm, my courage can help others be brave too.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: David's courage helped the whole army be brave. Who could your courage help this week?

quiz.question: What did the Philistines do when Goliath fell?
quiz.explanation: When the Philistines saw that their champion was dead, they fled.

quiz.question: What did Israel's army do after Goliath fell?
options: They shouted and chased the Philistines
quiz.explanation: The men of Israel and of Judah arose, shouted, and pursued the Philistines.

quiz.question: What did David say when Saul asked whose son he was?
options: 'I am the son of your servant Jesse.'
quiz.explanation: David answered, 'I am the son of your servant Jesse the Bethlehemite.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, the One who is in me is greater than anything in the world. Help me stand firm and trust You, so that my courage can help others be brave too. Amen.

companion.message: Did you see that? A whole army went from hiding to shouting! I didn't do anything special. I just trusted God, and He used it to give everyone courage.

review.notes: Goliath's beheading (17:51, 54) and the slain Philistines (17:52) are omitted; the pursuit is shown without fighting. Confirm.
